title: Exotic Chewy Middle Eastern Lamb Umm Ali
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dessert with a twist, featuring lamb and a chewy texture, wrapped in a corn husk and infused with sherry vinegar.
instructions: Soak the corn husks in water for 30 minutes to make them pliable.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, sherry vinegar, brine, sugar, rose water, and cardamom, and mix well.
Divide the lamb mixture into 12 equal pieces and shape each piece into a small ball.
Wrap each ball in a corn husk, making sure to seal the edges well.
Place the wrapped balls in a steamer basket and steam for 20 minutes.
Remove the balls from the steamer and let them cool.
Serve the Umm Ali warm, garnished with chopped pistachios.
